message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This file was autogenerated using `zio-sbt-ci` plugin via `sbt ciGenerateGithubWorkflow`
# task and should be included in the git repository. Please do not edit it manually.

name: CI
env:
  JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS: -XX:+PrintCommandLineFlags
'on':
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      docs-only:
        description: Set to true to skip the Maven release and only publish the docs to npm and notify zio/zio, for a version Maven Central already has
        required: false
        default: 'false'
  release:
    types:
    - published
  push:
    branches:
    - series/2.x
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore:
    - gh-pages
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && github.run_id || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: '17'
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Check all code compiles
      run: sbt --no-colors +Test/compile
    - name: Check artifacts build process
      run: sbt --no-colors +publishLocal
    - name: Compile examples
      run: sbt compileExamples
    - name: Mima check
      run: sbt mimaChecks
    - name: Undeclared dependencies check
      run: sbt undeclaredCompileDependencies
    - name: Unused dependencies check
      run: sbt unusedCompileDependenciesTest
    - name: MissingLink
      run: sbt missinglinkCheck
    - name: Setup NodeJs
      uses: actions/setup-node@v6
      with:
        node-version: '20'
    - name: Check website build process
      run: |-
        sbt docs/clean
        sbt docs/installWebsite
        sbt docs/mdoc
        node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='website/package.json',pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));pkg.overrides={webpack:'5.74.0'};fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2));"
        npm install --prefix website
        npm --prefix website run build
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: '17'
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Check if the site workflow is up to date
      run: sbt --no-colors ciCheckGithubWorkflow
    - name: Lint
      run: sbt --no-colors lint
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        java:
        - '17'
        - '21'
        - '25'
    steps:
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: ${{ matrix.java }}
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Test
      run: sbt --no-colors +test
  update-readme:
    name: Update README
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    if: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'release') && (github.event.action == 'published')) && ((github.event.release.target_commitish == 'series/2.x') || (github.event.release.target_commitish == 'refs/heads/series/2.x')) }}
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: '17'
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Generate Readme
      run: sbt --no-colors docs/generateReadme
    - name: Generate Token
      id: generate-token
      uses: zio/generate-github-app-token@v1.0.0
      with:
        app_id: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
        app_private_key: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
    - name: Create Pull Request
      id: cpr
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8.1.3
      with:
        body: |-
          Autogenerated changes after running the `sbt docs/generateReadme` command of the [zio-sbt-website](https://zio.dev/zio-sbt) plugin.

          I will automatically update the README.md file whenever there is new change for README.md, e.g.
            - After each release, I will update the version in the installation section.
            - After any changes to the "docs/index.md" file, I will update the README.md file accordingly.
        branch: zio-sbt-website/update-readme
        token: ${{ steps.generate-token.outputs.token }}
        delete-branch: true
        title: Update README.md
        add-paths: README.md
        base: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
        commit-message: Update README.md
    - name: Approve PR
      if: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
      run: gh pr review "$PR_URL" --approve
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        PR_URL: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-url }}
    - name: Enable Auto-Merge
      if: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-number }}
      run: gh pr merge --auto --squash "$PR_URL" || gh pr merge --squash "$PR_URL"
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.generate-token.outputs.token }}
        PR_URL: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull-request-url }}
  ci:
    name: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    needs:
    - lint
    - test
    - build
    if: always()
    steps:
    - name: Report Failed CI
      if: ${{ contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled') }}
      run: 'echo "ci failed: one or more required jobs did not succeed"; exit 1'
    - name: Report Successful CI
      run: echo "ci passed"
  release:
    name: Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    needs:
    - ci
    if: ${{ ((((github.event_name == 'release') && (github.event.action == 'published')) || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')) || ((github.event_name == 'push') && (github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch)))) && (github.event.inputs.docs-only != 'true') }}
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: '17'
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Release
      run: sbt --no-colors ci-release
      env:
        PGP_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.PGP_PASSPHRASE }}
        PGP_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PGP_SECRET }}
        SONATYPE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}
        SONATYPE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}
  release-docs:
    name: Release Docs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    needs:
    - release
    if: ${{ ((!cancelled()) && (((github.event_name == 'release') && (github.event.action == 'published')) || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'))) && ((needs.release.result == 'success') || ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && (github.event.inputs.docs-only == 'true'))) }}
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Setup Scala
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6.1.0
      with:
        distribution: corretto
        java-version: '17'
        check-latest: true
    - name: Setup SBT
      uses: sbt/setup-sbt@v1.5.12
    - name: Cache Dependencies
      uses: coursier/cache-action@v8.2.0
    - name: Setup NodeJs
      uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
      with:
        node-version: 24.22.1
        registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
    - name: Publish Docs to NPM Registry
      run: sbt --no-colors docs/publishToNpm
  notify-docs-release:
    name: Notify Docs Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: false
    needs:
    - release-docs
    if: ${{ ((!cancelled()) && (((github.event_name == 'release') && (github.event.action == 'published')) || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'))) && (needs.release-docs.result == 'success') }}
    steps:
    - name: Git Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - name: Check App Token
      id: check-app-token
      run: |
        if [ -n "$APP_ID" ]; then
          echo "configured=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "configured=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi
      env:
        APP_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
    - name: Generate Token
      id: generate-token
      uses: zio/generate-github-app-token@v1.0.0
      if: ${{ steps.check-app-token.outputs.configured == 'true' }}
      with:
        app_id: ${{ secrets.APP_ID }}
        app_private_key: ${{ secrets.APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        github_repo: zio/zio
    - name: notify the main repo about the new release of docs package
      run: |
        PACKAGE_NAME=$(cat docs/package.json | grep '"name"' | awk -F'"' '{print $4}')
        TAG="${RELEASE_TAG:-$(git tag --sort=committerdate | grep '^v' | tail -1 || true)}"
        if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then
          echo "::error::No release tag to take the docs package version from"
          exit 1
        fi
        PACKAGE_VERSION="${TAG#v}"
        for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
          if [ "$(npm view "$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION" version --prefer-online 2>/dev/null)" = "$PACKAGE_VERSION" ]; then
            break
          fi
          if [ "$attempt" = 30 ]; then
            echo "::error::$PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION is not on npm after 5 minutes"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Waiting for npm to list $PACKAGE_NAME@$PACKAGE_VERSION ($attempt/30)"
          sleep 10
        done
        curl -sSL --fail-with-body \
          -X POST \
          -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
          -H "Authorization: token $NOTIFY_TOKEN"\
            https://api.github.com/repos/zio/zio/dispatches \
            -d '{
                  "event_type":"update-docs",
                  "client_payload":{
                    "package_name":"'"${PACKAGE_NAME}"'",
                    "package_version": "'"${PACKAGE_VERSION}"'"
                  }
                }'
      env:
        NOTIFY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.generate-token.outputs.token || secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
        RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}",
  "rationale": "The test job runs a multi-Java matrix (17, 21, 25) with fail-fast: false, so all cells keep running even after one fails. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) is supported by retrieved experiment examples with scenario_passed outcomes, and the workflow's ci aggregation job still runs because the test job completes (failing cell still reports failure; only subsequent cells are cancelled). This preserves required-check coverage while saving VM time on failed runs. No other change is needed: dependency caching is already present via coursier/cache-action, and adding a custom timeout risks breaking valid slow sbt jobs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997"]
}
